summary: Marpai, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 2 to its 2022 Purchase Agreement with AXA S.A., restructuring earn-out and debt obligations from its prior acquisition of Maestro Health. The amendment defers the requirement to pay AXA 35% of net proceeds until after receiving $5 million in offering proceeds through December 31, 2026, and establishes minimum annual payments of $0 (2026), $1M (2027), $5M (2028), and $22.25M (2029). Marpai also agreed to incur no additional indebtedness beyond current outstanding debt. A press release notes $26.4 million in debt service reduction through 2027. This is a debt restructuring to improve near-term liquidity. Watch for the company's ability to raise offering proceeds and meet escalating payment obligations.
